title: Microsoft Edge: Commercial Journeys (Get things done) task cards on the Copilot new tab page
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft's current documentation supports the administrator opt-in, prerequisites, local retention and documented controls. The claim that users see this page most often is unconfirmed, and the checklist mentions a user opt-out control absent from the table.

claims.quote: Searched: "CommercialJourneysGetThingsDoneEnabled" "policy" reference. Opened Microsoft Edge - Policies and searched its full text for CommercialJourneys and Journeys; neither occurs. Search returned the feature article, not a policy reference.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The Copilot new tab page setting is at Settings > Microsoft Edge > Copilot > Copilot new tab page in Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: From the top navigation bar, switch to the Copilot tab. Click the dropdown beside Copilot new tab page and select Enabled. Get started with configuration policies: go to Settings > Microsoft Edge.

claims.claim: No specific API or automation command is documented for the Copilot new tab page setting, although registry configuration is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: CopilotNewTabPageEnabled automation command registry reg add. Opened the policy and configuration articles; they give registry values, ADMX and preference keys, not a specific automation call. Generic reg add documentation supplies no feature-specific call.

claims.claim: CopilotNewTabPageEnabled applies only to Entra ID profiles.
claims.quote: This policy applies only to Microsoft Entra ID profiles ... This policy does not apply to the Copilot new tab page on MSA profiles.

claims.claim: The documented mandatory Windows registry path is SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge.
claims.quote: Path (Mandatory): SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge; Value name: CopilotNewTabPageEnabled; Value type: REG_DWORD; Example registry value: 0x00000001

claims.claim: The Copilot new tab page setup article requires a Global admin or Edge admin account for the Edge management service.
claims.quote: sign in with an account that has Global admin or Edge admin privileges.
